TRAEFIK_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install traefik. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

TRAEFIK_VERSION.description: Specific version of traefik to install.

TRAEFIK_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading traefik binary or archive artifacts.

TRAEFIK_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying traefik available remote releases.
